retrievalProfile.description: A square composition featuring a central portrait against a rural landscape, framed by a thick black border with wide, extended sans-serif typography at the top and bottom.
triggerTerms: square album cover with black frame
rural landscape portrait with power lines
excludeWhen: designs requiring serif or script fonts

recipe.visualDefinition: A central photographic square depicting a man in a work shirt standing in a hilly, rural landscape with power lines, all contained within a thick black outer frame. The frame hosts bold, horizontally-extended sans-serif text in cream and yellow tones.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic square nested within a thick black border
Subject positioned right-of-center looking toward the viewer
Vanishing point of the road and power lines leading into the distance
Typography aligned to the top and bottom edges of the black frame
coreInvariants: Thick black outer border framing the central image
Desaturated, earthy color palette in the photograph

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure, positioned in the right foreground, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold cream-colored text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down to the subject's face, follow the power lines into the landscape, and finish at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the thick black border and the open sky in the photograph.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the black frame and the desaturated, naturalistic tones of the central photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic typeface family with variations in color and tracking to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, wide proportions and uniform stroke weight.
Provides the necessary geometric, wide-set appearance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photograph of a man in a light-colored work shirt standing in a rural, hilly landscape with a dirt road and power lines under a blue sky with light clouds. Place this square image inside a thick black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in an extended sans-serif font. The top text should be cream-colored and bold. The bottom text should be yellow, slightly smaller, and very widely tracked.

verificationChecks: Is the image square and centered within a black frame?
Is the top text cream and the bottom text yellow?
Does the photograph feature a rural landscape with power lines?

mustRedesign: Overlapping text on the central image

mustAchieve: Clear separation between image and border

postGenerationChecks: Check that the font is not condensed.
Ensure the black border is uniform on all sides.
Verify the subject is not obscured by text.
Confirm the color palette remains earthy and desaturated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square central photo + thick black frame + extended sans-serif headers = Americana Album Aesthetic
